sensors.name: line tracker as a light value (LIGHT mode, floor brightness)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the line tracker's light value is below 70, drive forward at 40 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if the front obstacle sensor sees something, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line; where there is no line (in the tunnel) drive straight without touching the walls; follow the line again after the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the line tracker's light value is below 70 (a black line reads 0, the peach floor reads about 83)

branches.outcome: below 70 (a black line): drive straight forward at 40 %
70 or more (no black line): go on to check for a wall

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is ahead in front of the robot

branches.outcome: no obstacle ahead: follow the line

branches.reason: reached only when the line tracker has just read 70 or more in the same frame, so it cannot see black at the same moment

input_dimensions.dimension: what is in front of the robot
what is in front of the robot

scenarios.coded_response: It drives straight forward at 40 % while the line tracker sees black
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on the black line, facing along it, with line ahead and nothing in front
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees the black line
scenarios.title: Follows the black line
assumptions: The end of the line is where it should get to.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the black line to its end

scenarios.coded_response: It checks for an obstacle, then curves right at 40 %/10 % over and over, circling
scenarios.initial_condition: The line tracker sees no black line (the peach floor, as inside the tunnel where there is no line), with nothing in front of the robot
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker stops seeing a line
scenarios.title: Drives straight where there is no line
assumptions: 'Inside a dark tunnel where there is no line, drive straight' means: where the line tracker sees no line, go straight.
Your program can't sense the tunnel's darkness, so the situation is the line tracker seeing no line.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives straight ahead without touching the tunnel's walls

scenarios.coded_response: It stops while the obstacle is in front
scenarios.initial_condition: The line tracker sees no line and an obstacle is in front of the robot
scenarios.trigger: The front obstacle sensor sees the obstacle
scenarios.title: Meets an obstacle after losing the line

uncertainties: The program reads the line tracker as a floor light value, not the room light: it cannot sense the tunnel's darkness, only whether a black line is under it.

The 'sees black' branch inside followLine never happens: it is only reached when the line tracker has just read 70 or more, so the robot never curves left and can only follow a straight or right-bending line.
Where there is no line your program curves right and circles instead of driving straight, and it senses nothing of the tunnel except an obstacle right in front.
You didn't say what the robot should do when it leaves the line and an obstacle is ahead, so that situation has no expected behaviour.

'Follow the line again after the tunnel' is not a situation of its own here: after losing the line the robot circles right, and whether it finds a line again depends on where it comes out, not on the program being right.

planned: On the black line, it drives to the goal
